svg.desc: Linux x64: CPU time, user and system, warm. CPU time, user and system: the complexity pack (8 rules at the new version, 8 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 1,410 ms, 0.1.5 1,760 ms; CPU time, user and system: the javascript pack (121 rules at the new version, 121 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 29,030 ms, 0.1.5 35,930 ms; CPU time, user and system: the rerail pack (34 rules at the new version, 34 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 2,720 ms, 0.1.5 3,250 ms; CPU time, user and system: the rust pack (33 rules at the new version, 33 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 9,770 ms, 0.1.5 13,170 ms; CPU time, user and system: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 1 core pinned (RERAIL_THREADS=1), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 29,630 ms, 0.1.5 16,850 ms; CPU time, user and system: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 31,590 ms, 0.1.5 17,620 ms;
